newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin unit wins $51.3 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin unit wins $51.3 mln contract.

text.p: Lockheed Martin said on Monday that its business unit had received a $51.3 million contract from the U.S. Army for extended-range missiles.
Lockheed Martin Vought Systems, a business unit of Lockheed Martin Electronics Sector, received the contract for its Army Tactical Missile System missiles, the company said in a statement.
ATACMS was the first tactical surface-to-surface missile fired in combat by the U.S. Army when it was deployed in Operation Desert Storm.
Long lead time item funding of $11.5 was received on the contract in December, Lockheed said, bringing the total for the 97 missile contract to $62.8 million.
Lockheed expects to deliver the missiles by April 1999, it added.
Lockheed Martin is involved in the design and development of advanced-technology products and services.
